# Hind AI

> A calm, theme-aware digital gurukul and library of ancient Indian scriptures powered by AI.

## Key Features
- **Scripture Shelves**: Direct access to Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, Puranas, and Epics.
- **Guru AI**: Streaming-based context-aware scriptural question answering.
- **Sadhana**: Mantra Japa counter and digital meditation tools.
- **Sanskrit Studio**: Translators, transliterations, dictionaries, and vocabulary analyzers.
- **Dharma Guide**: Structured context on rituals, festivals, and practices.
- **Culture**: Tirtha maps, festival encyclopedia, katha grantha, and Shridhar pothis.

## Primary Routes
- [Library Shelf](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/contents/): Explore cataloged ancient texts.
- [Guru AI Guide](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/ai-guide/): Interact with the scriptural assistant.
- [Daily Sadhana](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/sadhana/): Use the digital japa count tool.
- [Vision Analysis](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/vision/): Upload images of scripts and temples.
- [Dharma Guide](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/dharma/): Guidelines on spiritual paths.
- [Stotras Library](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/stotras/): Chant and listen to devotional hymns.
- [Festivals](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/festivals/): Utsav encyclopedia with living practice notes.
- [Tirtha map](https://mangeshraut712.github.io/Hindai/pilgrimage/): Jyotirlingas, peethas, Char Dham, Ashtavinayak.
